# Blu Idol (BLU = Bring Luxury to You)
> India's premier demi-fine jewellery brand offering 18K gold-plated, waterproof, anti-tarnish, and hypoallergenic pieces for sensitive skin.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: Blu Idol
- **Brand Acronym / Slogan**: BLU = Bring Luxury To You
- **Website**: https://www.bluidol.in
- **Customer Care & Direct WhatsApp Ordering**: +91 9895432549
- **Official Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/blu_idol/
- **Target Market**: India (Pan-India delivery)

## Core Value Propositions
- **18K Gold Vacuum-Plated**: Advanced PVD vacuum-plating process delivering enduring 18K yellow gold brilliance.
- **100% Skin-Safe & Hypoallergenic**: Guaranteed nickel-free and lead-free; specifically engineered for highly sensitive skin with zero irritation.
- **Waterproof & Sweat-Proof**: Resistant to water, sweat, humidity, and perfume. Suitable for everyday shower, workout, and swimming wear.
- **Anti-Tarnish Guarantee**: Lab-tested materials resist oxidation, fading, and discoloration over time.
- **Fair Luxury Pricing**: Luxury aesthetic accessible across India from ₹15 to ₹599 with 50-65% off retail.

## Regional Leadership & Anti-Tarnish Technology

### Why Kerala & India Choose Blu Idol Anti-Tarnish Jewellery
1. **Engineered for Tropical Humidity**: Standard imitation brass jewellery oxidizes rapidly in Kerala's coastal climate and heavy monsoon rains. Blu Idol's 18K vacuum PVD plating over 316L surgical stainless steel creates an airtight molecular bond that prevents tarnishing, rust, and green skin marks.
2. **Shower & Sweat Proof**: Customers can wear Blu Idol pieces during morning showers, daily gym workouts, temple visits, and humid outdoor events with zero loss of golden luster.
3. **Heritage Meets Modern Demi-Fine**: Features bridal and festive South Indian collections, including Kerala Elakkathali shimmering leaf chokers, traditional Manga Mala mango paisley sets, and Kasu Mala coin jewellery, as well as modern minimalist floating invisible-wire gems.
4. **Express Kerala Logistics**: Dispatched directly within Kerala for rapid 24 to 48 hour delivery to Ernakulam/Kochi, Trivandrum, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Kottayam, Kannur, and all 14 districts.

## Product Categories
- **Earrings**: Classic studs, huggies, statement drop earrings, and hoops designed for everyday elegance.
- **Jhumkas**: Handcrafted traditional and contemporary jhumka earrings featuring temple, peacock, floral, bell, and goddess motifs.
- **Necklaces**: Heritage temple chokers, Elakkathali sets, Manga Mala, delicate chains, 3D pendants, and multi-layer necklaces.
- **Bangles**: Handcrafted stainless steel 18K gold-plated bangles in traditional temple, openable cuff, and modern designer silhouettes.
  - **Gold Finish Bow Design Anti-Tarnish Stainless Steel Bangle**: ₹219 (MSRP: ₹449) — 18K gold-finished stainless steel hinged bangle featuring a charming bow motif accented with channel-set baguette cubic zirconia crystals. Waterproof and anti-tarnish.
- **Bracelets**: Minimalist tennis bracelets, chain cuffs, and dainty charm bracelets.
- **Anklets**: Anti-tarnish, waterproof payal and snake chains with protective charms.
- **Hair Clips**: Aesthetic acrylic, crystal flower, ribbon bow, and tulip hair claw clips.
- **Clip Combos**: Curated combo sets of Hawaiian hibiscus and floral wreath hair claw clips.
